# Compact toolbar choices and actions

<!-- Generated by scripts/sync-component-docs.mjs from ai/component-catalog.json and ai/component-composition.json. Do not edit; run `npm run catalog:sync`. -->

`@kerfjs/ui:recipe-compact-toolbar` · Kerf UI · production recipe · Recipes

## When to use

A compact toolbar that distinguishes grouped commands, a visible exclusive choice, a longer Select, and one ordinary action.

- A dense workspace toolbar mixes a few distinct control semantics.

**Not when:**

- Do not group unrelated actions or use buttons to imitate selection controls.

## Imports

- Nothing to import: this is a reference composition.
- Declared side effects: lazy-recipe-css, individual-custom-element-registration.

## Props

No props: this entry has no JavaScript API.

- Parents: used at the root of a screen or reference, not nested.

**The app owns:** controlled values; actions; persistence; responsive priority.

## Geometry

Margin: composed · border: composed · padding: composed (layout role: reference-composition). `self` means the component already owns it — do not add wrapper padding, margin, or borders around it.

## Accessibility

- Each control retains its own native name, pressed/value state, and keyboard contract.

## Styling boundary

The component owns its own styles. Configure it through its props and variants; do not override its internals.

Everything else is internal: `kerf-ui-analyze` reports private or unknown `.kui-*` selectors (`KUI-L001`, `KUI-L010`), unknown or private tokens (`KUI-L002`, `KUI-L012`), and forced component dimensions (`KUI-L005`).
